gloss: going into service (of a ship or aircraft)

definitions.gloss: going into service, entering service on a route
definitions.explanation: A ship, aircraft, or other transport beginning regular service on a route. Also used for the launch of a new route or service.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}しい{路線|ろせん}が{就航|しゅうこう}した。
examples.english: A new route went into service.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{東京|とうきょう}・ロンドン{間|かん}に{直行便|ちょっこうびん}が{就航|しゅうこう}する。
examples.english: A direct flight between Tokyo and London will begin service next month.

examples.japanese: この{大型|おおがた}フェリーは{昨年|さくねん}{就航|しゅうこう}したばかりだ。
examples.english: This large ferry just went into service last year.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{就|しゅう} (take up, enter) + {航|こう} (navigation, voyage). Literally "entering navigation."

USAGE:
Used almost exclusively for ships and aircraft. For trains and buses, {開通|かいつう} (opening of a route) or {運行|うんこう}{開始|かいし} (start of operation) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新|あら}たに{就航|しゅうこう}する: to newly enter service
- {直行便|ちょっこうびん}が{就航|しゅうこう}する: a direct flight enters service
- {就航|しゅうこう}{路線|ろせん}: service route
- {就航|しゅうこう}を{開始|かいし}する: to begin service
